criterion: Failure recovery is actionable at the point of failure
description: The failed chat's main assistant message still says only `Workspace setup failed. Try again in a moment.` even though Runtime Inspector identifies the real cause and recovery step.
expected: The failed message area should surface the same actionable recovery cause available in observability, or at least point directly to Runtime Inspector when richer failure evidence exists.
actual: The main chat required opening Runtime Inspector to learn that the ZAI profile key could not be decrypted and must be re-entered in Settings → Models.
suggested_fix: Enhance historical generic workspace-failure messages with a runtime-evidence callout or inline Runtime Inspector recovery link when a failed workflow has a likely issue.
